title: Platform Runner

entities.desc: a blue square 20x20 pixels that moves left/right with velocity and jumps when space is pressed
gray rectangles that form platforms of various heights and widths, positioned at different x,y coordinates
red squares 20x20 pixels that patrol back and forth on platforms with constant horizontal velocity
yellow circles 10x10 pixels that appear on platforms and disappear when collected by player
black rectangles that are 20 pixels wide and extend from platform height to bottom of screen
green rectangle 15x40 pixels that marks the level end at the far right of the level

mechanics: player spawns at left side of level with 3 lives
enemies patrol platforms with constant velocity, reverse direction at platform edges
player can stomp enemies from above to kill them and gain 100 points
player collects coins for 10 points each
player dies if they fall into pits or are touched by enemies
player wins by reaching the flag at level end
level is 2000 pixels wide with platforms, enemies, coins, and pits randomly placed
player gravity pulls them downward at 0.5 pixels per frame
player can only jump when touching ground or platform
screen follows player horizontally, showing 800 pixels of level at a time
win: player reaches the green flag at level end
render: draw player as blue square, ground as gray rectangles, enemies as red squares, coins as yellow circles, pits as black rectangles, flag as green rectangle
